hooks.command:
COMMAND=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
case "$COMMAND" in
  *"git commit"*)
    cd /Users/huzaifa/Ruby/rails/pulse_core || exit 2
    RUBOCOP_OUTPUT=$(bundle exec rubocop 2>&1)
    RUBOCOP_STATUS=$?
    if [ $RUBOCOP_STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: rubocop found offenses. Fix them before committing." >&2
      echo "$RUBOCOP_OUTPUT" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    ;;
esac
exit 0

COMMAND=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
case "$COMMAND" in
  *"git commit"*)
    cd /Users/huzaifa/Ruby/rails/pulse_core || exit 2
    RSPEC_OUTPUT=$(bundle exec rspec 2>&1)
    RSPEC_STATUS=$?
    if [ $RSPEC_STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: rspec has failing examples. Fix them before committing." >&2
      echo "$RSPEC_OUTPUT" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    ;;
esac
exit 0
